notes_for_editor: Build year is only the decade ('built in the 1940s', Register); no event year was assigned for construction. Access is unknown: no source says whether the public may visit or climb, and the 2006 visit report mentions a climbing sign and broken cab glass, so the story advises against climbing. Record coordinates and elevation (619 m) match the Register. The Eastern US lookouts page gives little beyond county and district. Search snippets (a CCC Camp P-62 Facebook post saying the camp built several area towers) were not fetched and are not used; they do not name Altamont. Worth a human look: whether the Register's 2006 visit still reflects current condition, and whether the Division of Forestry allows visitors.
